settings.text: One inbox, answered by a person. Most messages get a reply the same working day.

settings.heading: Send us a message
settings.text: Question about an order, a product or a return? Fill in the form and we will get back to you within one business day.
settings.success_text: Thanks for reaching out. We will reply within one business day.

settings.question: Where is my order?
settings.answer: Check the tracking link in your shipping confirmation email first. If tracking has not moved in five days, send us your order number and we will chase it.

settings.question: Can I change or cancel my order?
settings.answer: If it has not shipped yet, yes. Email us with your order number as soon as you can and we will do our best to catch it before dispatch.

settings.question: Something arrived damaged. What now?
settings.answer: Send us a photo and your order number. We will send a replacement or refund you, whichever you prefer, and you will not need to pay return postage.
